root_causes.description: product-catalog, a leaf dependency of recommendation/checkout/frontend, shows sustained server-side latency far above its ~2ms baseline for the entire incident window, with no errors, CPU, or memory pressure. This stalls every catalog browse and recommendation path and is the origin of the cluster-wide p99 latency spike.

evidence.expected_baseline: no errors; consistent with pure latency injection, rules out http_abort

evidence.observed_value: search_traces(product-catalog, min_duration_ms=1500): 20 traces, 0 errors, p95_duration=413279ms; span user_browse_product=15000ms
product-catalog pod shows busybox:latest pull plus 'Killing: Stopping container product-catalog' and 'SuccessfulCreate: Created pod: product-catalog-5bb7676754-hcfpv' during window
evidence.expected_baseline: no pod recreation / no busybox helper container in steady state (chaos injection marker)

root_causes.description: recommendation is pinned at the histogram ceiling (p50=p99=10000ms) for the whole window and produced the longest frontend traces (~164s), consistent with inheriting product-catalog's injected latency plus retry/queue amplification upstream.

evidence.expected_baseline: p99 < ~50ms (recommendation normally mirrors fast product-catalog lookups)

root_causes.description: frontend/checkout sit at the latency ceiling (p50=p99=10000ms) and frontend emitted a transient error burst at window start while its product-catalog/recommendation dependencies hung — propagation of the product-catalog latency, not an independent fault.

evidence.expected_baseline: flat low CPU; frontend is not resource constrained

remediation_steps: Confirm a latency chaos experiment (e.g. Chaos Mesh NetworkChaos/HTTPChaos with a busybox helper) is targeting the product-catalog pod; the busybox pull + container kill event is the injection marker.
Remove/pause the chaos experiment on product-catalog and verify its server p99 returns to ~single-digit ms; watch recommendation/checkout/frontend p99 recover downstream within minutes.

If the delay is not chaos-injected, inspect product-catalog's upstream data source (product DB / file load) for a slow dependency and add a request timeout + circuit breaker so a slow catalog cannot hang checkout/recommendation.
Add latency SLO alerts on product-catalog p99 and on the frontend BrowseProduct/GetRecommendations endpoints to catch this leaf-level regression earlier.
Tune recommendation's retry budget so a stalled product-catalog call cannot amplify to ~164s end-to-end traces.
